description: Index of the Multipass-owned secret payload contracts. The JSON Schema files under schemas/ are maintained as source files and copied unchanged by consumers; text codecs have no schema. Field name mapping: secret_content_type here and in schemas/helpers is the existing protocol field content_type (SecretTypeDefinition.content_type); no wire, stored-byte or AAD value changes.

stored_compat.opaque: generic may hold bytes that are not UTF-8 and any value up to max_value_bytes; a content_type outside this list, or a legacy type (totp, ...), is kept as an opaque value and never rejected on read.
stored_compat.typed: A stored value of a listed type opens as that type when decode_typed_value and validate_typed_value both pass. Blank optional strings and empty optional lists are ignored by validation (blank_means_absent), so the schema describes the document after they are dropped.

producer_profile.note: A producer writes only what the schema asserts: no blank optional string, no empty optional list, no JSON for a text codec, and only a listed type. Fixture index producer.accept records which cases satisfy it; stored records which the receiver opens.

semantic_rule_note: A schema carries x-semantic ids and x-max-utf8-bytes as annotations. JSON Schema cannot assert them; the receiver enforces them in secret_types::semantic and validate.

text_codec.stored_as: the field value's UTF-8 bytes, verbatim: no JSON framing, trimming or normalization
